entries.name: Series 79 Investment Banking Representative
entries.definition: A FINRA qualification exam and registration for investment bankers who advise on securities offerings and mergers and acquisitions.

entries.name: Series 86 Research Analyst (Analysis)
entries.definition: The securities-analysis part of FINRA's research analyst qualification exams, covering valuation and financial analysis.

entries.name: Series 9 General Securities Sales Supervisor (Options Module)
entries.definition: A FINRA qualification exam and registration for general securities sales supervisors, covering the supervision of options sales.
variants: Series 9 General Securities Sales Supervisor License : Options

entries.name: Series 99 Operations Professional
entries.definition: A FINRA qualification exam and registration for operations staff at broker-dealers.

entries.name: ServSafe Alcohol
entries.definition: A responsible-alcohol-service certification from the National Restaurant Association's ServSafe program.

entries.name: Six Sigma Black Belt
entries.definition: A certification for people who lead Six Sigma process-improvement projects, higher than the Green Belt.

entries.name: Six Sigma Green Belt
entries.definition: A certification for people who take part in or lead smaller Six Sigma process-improvement projects, below the Black Belt.

entries.name: Specialist in Blood Banking
entries.definition: A certification from the ASCP Board of Certification for laboratory professionals who specialise in blood banking and transfusion medicine.

entries.name: Sun Certified Enterprise Architect
entries.definition: A Sun Microsystems certification, later taken over by Oracle, for architects who design enterprise applications on the Java platform.

entries.name: Tanker and hazmat combination endorsement
entries.definition: A commercial driver's licence endorsement, coded X, that combines the tanker and hazardous materials endorsements.
variants: Tanker And Hazmat Combo X Endorsement

entries.name: Tanker endorsement
entries.definition: A commercial driver's licence endorsement, issued by a US state, that permits driving a tank vehicle that carries liquids or gases in bulk.

entries.name: Taxi license
entries.definition: A licence issued by a city or state authority that allows a person or vehicle to operate as a taxi.

entries.name: Trauma Nurse Core Course
entries.definition: A course from the Emergency Nurses Association that teaches nurses a structured approach to assessing and caring for trauma patients and awards a provider card on completion.

entries.name: Web programming certificate
entries.definition: A certificate awarded for completing a course of study in web programming.

entries.name: Web technologies certificate
entries.definition: A certificate awarded for completing a course of study in web technologies.

entries.name: Wicklander-Zulawski certification
entries.definition: A certification awarded by Wicklander-Zulawski & Associates to people who complete its training in investigative interviewing and interrogation.

entries.name: Wilderness EMT
entries.definition: Emergency medical technician training combined with wilderness medicine, for treating patients far from hospital care, awarded as a course certificate by various outdoor and medical training providers.

entries.name: Wilderness First Responder
entries.definition: A wilderness medicine certification, taught by several training providers, for people who give emergency care in remote places where help is hours away.

entries.name: Zend Certified PHP Engineer
entries.definition: A certification from Zend that shows a PHP developer has passed its exam.
